items.title: How many active-recall sessions does it take to close a gap like Priya's?
items.description: Wednesday's cold quiz scored 40% (6 of 15, no sheet) after five passive rereads produced zero retrieval practice. Drag the slider to see how short, targeted active-recall sessions between Wednesday night and Friday change the retest score — the curve is fit to match what actually happened: 3 sessions closed the gap to 93% (14/15).

params.name: sessions
params.label: Active-recall sessions after the cold quiz

items.compute: const amplitude = 56; const score = 40 + amplitude * (1 - Math.exp(-params.sessions)); return { score: Math.round(score) };
